name: Terrarium 70x27x30
label: Large terrarium
lead: Glass terrarium measuring 70x27x30 cm. Volume: 56.7 liters, horizontal format. Handmade in Novi Sad.

description.html: This terrarium is 70 cm long but only 27 cm wide. The floor has 1890 cm², the height is 30 cm and the volume is about 57 liters. The narrow size is made for shelves and niches that a 40 cm deep terrarium does not fit into.

A narrow, long space suits snakes, which move along the walls. A young corn snake or a young ball python has a hide at each end here and 70 cm between them for a temperature gradient. For tortoises, 27 cm of width is too tight for turning around, so it does not suit them. Adult bearded dragons cannot go in this size either.

If your shelf allows more, the 70x40x35 model gives almost 50% more floor on the same length. We adjust the length and width to the niche down to the centimeter. Building it takes 7 to 14 days. The film on the outside is chosen from 34 patterns, so the terrarium can match the color of the shelf.
